<thought>This is a flexible bring-3 singles core built around strong individual threats with good type synergy. Garchomp, Dragapult and Kingambit apply offensive pressure. Gholdengo, Rotom-Wash and Clefable provide bulky pivoting, hazard and status control, and answers to opposing Dragons, Fighting types and setup sweepers. That gives me a sound three to bring into most team previews.</thought>
<pokemon>
Garchomp
Kingambit
Gholdengo
Dragapult
Rotom-Wash
Clefable
</pokemon>
attempts.reasoning:
This is Gen 9 Champions BSS singles with a bring-3 format, likely with megas legal. I'm leaning toward strong singles picks like Garchomp, Kingambit, and Gholdengo to build a balanced core.

Settling on Garchomp, Kingambit, Gholdengo, Dragapult, Rotom-Wash, and Clefable for fairy coverage against dragons—that rounds out the team nicely.

attempts.answer:
<thought>Garchomp holds its Mega Stone to be the main physical wincon. Kingambit (Supreme Overlord) cleans up late with priority Sucker Punch, and Dragapult hits fast with Life Orb and can pivot with U-turn. Scarf Gholdengo gives a fast Make It Rain nuke and can Trick its Scarf onto walls. Rotom-Wash and Unaware Clefable handle the defensive side: burns, pivoting, and walling setup sweepers.</thought>

I'm working through item assignments, considering Garchompite for Garchomp while weighing whether Clefable should get Clefablite or just Leftovers, since multiple megas can be held even if only one activates per battle.

Now I'm drafting the full team: Kingambit with Black Glasses, Gholdengo with Choice Scarf, Dragapult with Life Orb or Focus Sash, Rotom-Wash with Sitrus Berry, and Clefable with Leftovers. I'm allocating stat points within the 32-per-stat cap and sketching movesets for each—Garchomp's physical sweeper set, Kingambit's Supreme Overlord attacker, Gholdengo's scarf set, and starting on Dragapult's physical Dragon Darts build.

Actually Calm Mind with Unaware feels redundant, but it still works for Moonblast, Calm Mind, Moonlight, Flamethrower with Bold nature spread of 32 HP/32 Def/2 SpD.
